Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: Saved intercompany reconciliation state (companies, movements, difference comments, and active period) for cloud persistence and shareable viewing.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reconciliation owner

ownerName.description: Display name of the user who saved the reconciliation

title.description: Descriptive title of the saved reconciliation

entities.description: Ordered list of companies feeding the reconciliation matrices

movements.description: Intercompany CXC and CXP movement items

comments.description: Map of pair IDs to editable difference explanations

closedMonths.description: Map of closed month keys to immutable closure metadata and snapshots

entitiesCount.description: Total number of configured companies saved

ClosedPeriod.title: ClosedPeriod
ClosedPeriod.description: Immutable permanent archive of a closed monthly reconciliation.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who closed the period

ownerName.description: Display name of the user who closed the period

title.description: Title of the closed reconciliation period

entities.description: Frozen list of companies at the time of closing

movements.description: Frozen list of monthly movements at the time of closing

comments.description: Frozen map of difference comments at the time of closing

movementsCount.description: Number of movements in the closed month

differencesCount.description: Number of pending differences at closure

closedAtIso.description: ISO timestamp when the month was closed

CompanyDirectory.title: CompanyDirectory
CompanyDirectory.description: Independent master catalog of companies (name, NIT, contact email, code, country, currency, matrix order) per scope, editable regardless of closed reconciliation months.

entitiesCount.description: Total number of companies in the directory

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the last user who updated the company directory

updatedByName.description: Display name of the last user who updated the company directory

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial directory creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last directory update

/reconciliations/{reconciliationId}.description: Stores saved intercompany reconciliations that can be updated by their owner and viewed via a shared link.

/closed_periods/{archiveId}.description: Stores permanent, append-only immutable archives of closed monthly reconciliations.

/company_directories/{scopeId}.description: Stores independent company directories per scope (internacionales, nacionales) editable independently of closed months.
